name: codex-mcp
description: Lets Codex on this PC talk to the Unify3D agent in SolidWorks: send it a message and get its reply, and read the open model. Changes it asks for still need your OK in the Unify3D panel. Adds an MCP server named "unify3d" to Codex's config.toml, which the Codex app, CLI and IDE extension share. Works on this PC only; no agent-bridge needed.

allowModelRead.title: Let Codex read the open model
allowModelRead.description: The unify3d_* tools: model summary, feature tree, selection, open documents.
